title: Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting on or after November 25, 2026, Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Lakeflow Jobs now show query performance metrics and insights at the job level for supported tasks. You can view job-level data volume metrics and use the **Optimize** button to open Genie Code to help improve queries with performance insights. Query profiling is supported for serverless compute, SQL Warehouses and Lakeflow Pipelines.

See [View query performance metrics for serverless jobs](/aws/en/jobs/diagnose-job-performance#query-performance-metrics).

ref_links.text: View query performance metrics for serverless jobs
